dimred.why: Rotating a point cloud and watching variance captured builds PCA intuition that formulas alone do not.

anomaly.why: Moving a threshold and seeing precision and recall trade off teaches alert tuning better than any definition.

timeseries.why: Trying baselines and alpha on a live series, then backtesting real data yourself, makes forecasting stick.

recsys.why: The ideas stack from baseline to hybrid; building each method and scoring it offline is how they sink in.
